    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(age_maturity=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,10]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(age_maturity=mean(age_maturity), .by = "sp")->fishbase_age_maturity
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_age_maturity) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=age_maturity))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=age_maturity))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->age_maturity_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(age_maturity ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_age_maturity <- brm(age_maturity ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                age_maturity_plots=age_maturity_plots,
                model_brms_age_maturity=model_brms_age_maturity))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_age_maturity)->model_age_maturity
  names(model_age_maturity)<-cafe_cols
  model_age_maturity %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_age_maturity.rds")

12.4 Average temperature ~ gene copy number

Average temperature from portion of population sampled (celcius)

 #average temperature from portion of population sampled (celcius)
  brms_model_temp<-function(col){
   library(brms)
   
   cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
   #lead the genecopy data
   orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                pull(genes))) %>% 
     filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
     pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
     replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
   #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
   
   expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
   scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
   pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
   pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
     rownames_to_column("sp")
   
   #Get this data from FishLife
   data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
   tibble(temperature=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,6]) %>%
     mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
     drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     summarise(mean_temp=mean(temperature), .by = "sp")->fishbase_temperature_dat
   
   #join the datasets
   left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_temperature_dat) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
   
   #Prune the pglmm tree
   pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
   is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   #Must pass namecheck
   geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
   
   #plots to visualise response and predictors
   ggarrange(
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=mean_temp))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=mean_temp))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->temp_plots
   
   #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
   A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
   A<-A$Ainv
   #Priors
   priors<-get_prior(mean_temp ~  
                       PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                         data = model_dat,
                         data2   = list(A = A),
                         family = skew_normal(link = "identity"))
   #Model
   model_brms_temp <- brm(mean_temp ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
     data = model_dat,
     data2   = list(A = A),
     prior = priors,
     family = skew_normal(link = "identity"),
     chains = 4, 
     cores = 4,
     iter = 5000, 
     warmup = 1000,
     backend = "cmdstanr",
     control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
   )
   
   
   return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
               temp_plots=temp_plots,
               model_brms_temp=model_brms_temp))
 }

12.5 Trophic level ~ gene copy variation

Trophic level (dimensionless), where 1 is primary producers, etc.

 brms_model_trophic<-function(col){
   library(brms)
   
   cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
   #lead the genecopy data
   orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                pull(genes))) %>% 
     filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label & sp != "Danio_rerio") %>% 
     dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
     pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
     replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide

   expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
   scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
   pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
   pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
     rownames_to_column("sp")
   
   #Get this data from FishLife
   data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
   tibble(trophic_level=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,2]) %>%
     mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
     drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     summarise(trophic_level=mean(trophic_level), .by = "sp")->fishbase_trophiclevel
   
   #join the datasets
   left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_trophiclevel) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
   
   #Prune the pglmm tree
   pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
   is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   #Must pass namecheck
   geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
   
   #plots to visualise response and predictors
   ggarrange(
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=trophic_level))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=trophic_level))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->trophic_plots
   
   #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
   A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
   A<-A$Ainv
   #Priors
   priors<-get_prior(trophic_level ~  
                       PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                     data = model_dat,
                     data2   = list(A = A),
                     family = skew_normal(link = "identity"))
   #Model
   model_brms_trophic <- brm(trophic_level ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
     data = model_dat,
     data2   = list(A = A),
     prior = priors,
     family = skew_normal(link = "identity"),
     chains = 4, 
     cores = 4,
     iter = 5000, 
     warmup = 1000,
     backend = "cmdstanr",
     control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
   )
   
   
   return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
               trophic_plots=trophic_plots,
               model_brms_trophic=model_brms_trophic))
 }

12.6 Growth coefficient ~ gene copy variation

von Bertalanffy growth coefficient (year^-1)

   brms_model_growthcoeff<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(growth_coefficient=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,5]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(growth_coefficient=mean(growth_coefficient), .by = "sp")->fishbase_growth_coefficient
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_growth_coefficient) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=growth_coefficient))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=growth_coefficient))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->growthcoeff_plots
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(growth_coefficient ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_growthcoeff <- brm(growth_coefficient ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                growthcoeff_plots=growthcoeff_plots,
                model_brms_growthcoeff=model_brms_growthcoeff))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_growthcoeff)->model_growthcoeff
  names(model_growthcoeff)<-cafe_cols
  model_growthcoeff %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_growthcoeff.rds")

12.7 Bodyshape ~ gene copy variation

Body shape categories

 brms_model_bodyshape<-function(col){
   
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    rbind( 
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,26]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "elongated", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,27]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "short_and_or_deep", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,28]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "eellike", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,29]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "other", 
                                    .default = "other")))->fishbase_bodyshape_dat
    
    #join the datasets
    #Remove spare "other" category
    
    left_join(pca_gene,
              fishbase_bodyshape_dat %>% filter(bodyshape!="other")) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    model_dat %>% ggplot(aes(x=PC1.cpy, PC2.cpy))+
      geom_point(aes(fill=bodyshape), size=3, alpha=0.8, shape=21,
                 position = position_jitter(width = 2, height = 2))+
      scale_fill_bmj()+
      theme_linedraw()->bodyshape_plots
  
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors; use the following prior set
    #Most of the are default values, except the prior for the phylogenetic effect
    #this tight prior ensures better model convergence 
    
   priors <- c(brms::prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", dpar = "muelongated"),
               brms::prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mushortandordeep"),
               brms::prior("student_t(3, 0, 1.5)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "muelongated"),
               brms::prior("student_t(3, 0, 1.5)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mushortandordeep"),
               brms::prior("student_t(3, 0, 0.5)", class = "sd", group = "sp", dpar = "muelongated"),brms::prior("student_t(3, 0, 0.5)", class = "sd", group = "sp", dpar = "mushortandordeep")
)


  
    #Model
    model_brms_bodyshape <- brm(bodyshape ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy + (1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = categorical(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 4000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.99, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                bodyshape_plots=bodyshape_plots,
                model_brms_bodyshape=model_brms_bodyshape))
  }

  janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_bodyshape)->model_bodyshape
names(model_bodyshape)<-cafe_cols
model_bodyshape %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_bodyshape.rds")

12.8 Habitat ~ gene copy variation

Demersal type for habitat category

  brms_model_habitat<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    rbind( 
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,20]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "bathymetric", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,21]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "benthopelagic", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,22]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "reefassociated", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,23]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "pelagic", 
                                  .default = "other")))->fishbase_habitat_dat
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_habitat_dat) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    model_dat %>% ggplot(aes(x=PC1.cpy, PC2.cpy))+
      geom_point(aes(fill=habitat), size=3, alpha=0.8, shape=21,
                 position = position_jitter(width = 2, height = 2))+
      scale_fill_bmj()+
      theme_linedraw()->habitat_plots
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(habitat ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = categorical())
    #Model
    model_brms_habitat <- brm(
      habitat ~  PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy + (1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = categorical(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 4000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                habitat_plots=habitat_plots,
                model_brms_habitat=model_brms_habitat))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_habitat)->model_habitat
  names(model_habitat)<-cafe_cols
  model_habitat %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_habitat.rds")

12.9 Aspect ratio ~ gene copy variation

Caudal fin height and length divided by area (dimensionless)

  brms_model_aspect_ratio<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(aspect_ratio=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,3]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(aspect_ratio=mean(aspect_ratio), .by = "sp")->fishbase_aspect_ratio
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_aspect_ratio) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=aspect_ratio))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=aspect_ratio))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->aspect_ratio_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(aspect_ratio ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_aspect_ratio <- brm(
      aspect_ratio ~  
        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                aspect_ratio_plots=aspect_ratio_plots,
                model_brms_aspect_ratio=model_brms_aspect_ratio))
  }

  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_aspect_ratio)->model_aspect_ratio
  names(model_aspect_ratio)<-cafe_cols
  model_aspect_ratio %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_aspect_ratio.rds")

12.10 Lower jaw length ~ gene copy variation

Length of lower jaw (cm)

  brms_model_lower_jaw_length<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(lower_jaw_length=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,15]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(lower_jaw_length=mean(lower_jaw_length), .by = "sp")->fishbase_lower_jaw_length
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_lower_jaw_length) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=lower_jaw_length))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=lower_jaw_length))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->lower_jaw_length_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(lower_jaw_length ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_lower_jaw_length <- brm(lower_jaw_length ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                lower_jaw_length_plots=lower_jaw_length_plots,
                model_brms_lower_jaw_length=model_brms_lower_jaw_length))
  }

cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>%
  janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_lower_jaw_length)->model_lower_jaw_length
  names(model_lower_jaw_length)<-cafe_cols
  model_lower_jaw_length %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_lower_jaw_length.rds")

13 Functional characterisation of genes

Here I functionally characterise the high turnover genes to determine whether they can have an affect on the traits they have a relationship with. I do not focus on the unreliable ones because they are likely driven by outliers. The functional characterisation involved looking at which tissues the high turnover genes are expressed in, using data from Bgee. Then I look at expression of these genes at the single cell level during embryonic development in zebrafish, followed by contrasting the expression in post embryonic development. I then look for specificity of expression of the genes during metamorphosis in clownfish and grouper. Lastly, I analyse perturbation data of the modules of which the high turnover genes are members of using the ZFIN database.
Collectively, this section tells me whether the genes are expressed in the relevant cell and tissue types where we predicted an association with a particular phenotype, how they function during embryonic and post embryonic development, and whether there is any specificity in their activity during metamorphosis.

13.4 Functional analyses

13.4.1 Translation process

Variation in gene copies in the translation module is linked with variation in age of maturity, bodyshape, and aspect ratio.

13.4.1.1 Expression in Bgee.

14 Random network

To ensure that the modules we obtain represent biologically meaningful grouping of genes due to their coordinated expression during post-embryonic development, we constructed networks using permuted gene expression values and compared the network structures. The random networks failed to achieve scale free topology, have vastly different connectivities, and are not enriched for the same biological processes, and the modules do not show any preservation between species. Therefore, the modules from our original networks are a biologically meaningful representation of coordinated gene activity during post-embryonic development, and not simply transcriptomic grouping of housekeeping genes.

14.1 Setup

To make the row-wise permutation for each gene, randomly shuffle its 21 expression values (for the clownfish data) across samples. This preserves each gene’s expression distribution, mean, and variance, but breaks the coordinated expression structure between genes. This is the appropriate null if you want to observe any clustering simply due transcriptomic grouping of housekeeping genes

### Do permutation 
permute_expression_by_gene <- function(expr_mat, seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  expr_perm <- seq_len(nrow(expr_mat)) %>%
    purrr::map(\(i) sample(expr_mat[i, ])) %>%
    do.call(rbind, args = .) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  rownames(expr_perm) <- rownames(expr_mat)
  colnames(expr_perm) <- colnames(expr_mat)
  
  expr_perm
}

#Clownfish
expr_perm_clown_orth_net_in <- permute_expression_by_gene(t(clown_orth_net_in$wgcna_in), 
                                        seed = 123) %>% t()
#Goby
expr_perm_goby_orth_net_in <- permute_expression_by_gene(t(goby_orth_net_in$wgcna_in), 
                                        seed = 123) %>% t()

#Grouper
expr_perm_grouper_orth_net_in <- permute_expression_by_gene(t(grouper_orth_net_in$wgcna_in), 
                                        seed = 123) %>% t()

#Manini
expr_perm_manini_orth_net_in <- permute_expression_by_gene(t(manini_orth_net_in$wgcna_in), 
                                        seed = 123) %>% t()
#Danio
expr_perm_danio_orth_net_in <- permute_expression_by_gene(t(danio_orth_net_in$wgcna_in), 
                                        seed = 123) %>% t()

### SoftThreshold and network construction
soft_threshold(expr_perm_clown_orth_net_in)->sft_clown_orth_net_random#pick 13 
soft_threshold(expr_perm_goby_orth_net_in)->sft_goby_orth_net_random #pick 13
soft_threshold(expr_perm_grouper_orth_net_in)->sft_grouper_orth_net_random #pick 12
soft_threshold(expr_perm_manini_orth_net_in)->sft_manini_orth_net_random #pick 13
soft_threshold(expr_perm_danio_orth_net_in)->sft_danio_orth_net_random #pick 13

rbind(sft_clown_orth_net_random$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="clown"),
      sft_grouper_orth_net_random$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="grouper"),
      sft_goby_orth_net_random$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="goby"),
      sft_manini_orth_net_random$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="manini"),
      sft_danio_orth_net_random$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="danio")) %>% dplyr::select(sp,Power,SFT.R.sq,mean.k.,median.k.,max.k.,Density) %>% filter(SFT.R.sq>0.8 & median.k.>10) %>% view()


#Pick soft threshold power for random networks. I pick the power that gives comparable mean k as the normal network.

#Clown
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = expr_perm_clown_orth_net_in, power = 8)->clown_orth_net_random

#Grouper
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = expr_perm_grouper_orth_net_in, power = 8)->grouper_orth_net_random

#Goby
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = expr_perm_goby_orth_net_in, power = 8)->goby_orth_net_random

#Manini
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = expr_perm_manini_orth_net_in, power = 8)->manini_orth_net_random

#Danio
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = expr_perm_danio_orth_net_in, power = 8)->danio_orth_net_random

clown_orth_net_random %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/clown_orth_net_random.rds")
grouper_orth_net_random %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/grouper_orth_net_random.rds")
goby_orth_net_random %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/goby_orth_net_random.rds")
manini_orth_net_random %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/manini_orth_net_random.rds")
danio_orth_net_random %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_orth_net_random.rds")

### Random module preservation
#### Module preservation of random modules ##########
#For clownfish and grouper
setLabels = c("clown", "grouper");
multiExpr = list(clown = list(data = expr_perm_clown_orth_net_in), 
                 grouper = list(data = expr_perm_grouper_orth_net_in));
multiColor = list(clown = clown_orth_net_random$moduleColors$moduleColors, 
                  groper = grouper_orth_net_random$moduleColors$moduleColors);
nSets = 2

mp = modulePreservation(multiExpr, multiColor,
                        referenceNetworks = c(1:2),
                        nPermutations = 200,
                        randomSeed = 1,
                        verbose = 3)
mp %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/random_orth_module_pres_clownfish_grouper.rds")
